narrative.northStar: The Mars Transit Bio-Astronautics Clinical Command Ledger
narrative.overview: TARSCARE AI is an operational spacecraft medical workstation designed for deep-space habitats under low ambient light and up to 22-minute one-way communication delays from Earth. The interface fuses NASA Flight Surgeon console scanability with flight-data cue-card precision.
keyCharacteristics: Deep orbital navy ground (#070b14) paired with layered slate-navy instrument panels (#0d1424 and #131d33).
Strict 1px structural borders (#1e2d4a) and keyed provenance/citation badges.
High-salience directional alert and emergency protocol strips.
Tabular numeric alignment across all dosimetry, cardiovascular, and ECLSS atmospheric tables.

rules.name: The Semantic State Exclusivity Rule
rules.body: Emerald, Amber, and Crimson appear only when encoding NORMAL, WARNING, or CRITICAL medical/environmental states—never as decorative card accents.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Every numeric readout, baseline delta, timestamp, and dosimetric table enforces font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so digits align vertically across longitudinal Sol comparisons.

rules.name: The Zero-Halo Rule
rules.body: Never use zero-offset colored neon glows (0 0 15px); all shadows carry a downward vertical offset and soft dark-navy blur.

dos: Do distinguish physical absorbed radiation dose (mGy) from biologically weighted equivalent/effective dose (mSv) in every radiation readout.
Do display an explicit provenance badge (SYNTHETIC_DEMO, USER_ENTERED, SIMULATED_ENV, REAL_RESEARCH_REF) on every telemetry record and citation.
Do compare physiological measurements against the astronaut's personal baseline and current gravity regime (0g, 0.38g, 1.0g).
donts: Don't place small uppercase kicker or eyebrow labels above headings; let headings carry their own hierarchy.
Don't use thick colored left borders (border-left > 1px), gradient text, or decorative glassmorphism.
Don't represent NASA Radiation Data Portal (ARMAS) Earth aviation measurements as direct Martian surface telemetry, or claim clinical validation for prototype decision rules.
